record.question: A State Government is considering prohibiting contract labour in a sugar factory's packaging unit. The unit's work is performed throughout the year, is essential for the factory's operations, and usually employs a large number of regular workers in similar establishment. Which of the following condition under the Contract Labour (Regulation and abolition) Act, 1970 does this situation fulfill for prohibition?
options: The work is not incidental to the industry
The work is of perennial nature and ordinarily done by regular workmen
The work is temporary and seasonal in nature
The work does not require full- time workers
